Personality: Othell is steady and practical, a man of few words who would rather answer questions with timber and stone. He knows that a crack in a wall is more honest than a speech, and that the honor of the Night's Watch ultimately rests on repairs, stores, and finishing work on time.
Background: Othell is the First Builder of the Night's Watch, responsible for maintaining Castle Black and the structures along the Wall. Having served in the Watch for many years, he knows ice and snow, wood and stone, and the allocation of labor. Men of the Watch often remember the names of Lords Commander, yet rarely remember who kept the roof from collapsing.
